description: This file defines the class WorkSpacesClient which acts as a client for interacting with the Amazon WorkSpaces service via the AWS SDK for PHP. It declares numerous methods corresponding to API actions, each annotated for IDE autocomplete, and extends the base AwsClient class.

classes.name: WorkSpacesClient
classes.description: A client class to interact with AWS WorkSpaces service, providing methods for various operations such as creating, deleting, and describing workspaces, as well as managing related resources.

methods.name: acceptAccountLinkInvitation
methods.description: Accepts an account link invitation in AWS WorkSpaces.

methods.name: associateConnectionAlias
methods.description: Associates a connection alias with a directory.

methods.name: createWorkspaceImage
methods.description: Creates a new custom image from an existing Workspace.
